guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, aux_rand_q is asynchronously cleared to '0.
At each positive edge of clk_i while rst_ni is high, aux_rand_q is updated with aux_rand_d.

assumptions.claim: aux_rand_d is stable and meets setup/hold timing at the rising edge of clk_i.
assumptions.cond: at every posedge clk_i when rst_ni is high
assumptions.risk: aux_rand_q may capture a metastable or incorrect value, corrupting downstream randomness.

uncertain_points.claim: The source of aux_rand_d is not visible in this chunk; it may be updated only under certain conditions, leaving stale or invalid values at other times.
uncertain_points.risk: aux_rand_q may capture a non-valid value that pretends to be entropy, potentially breaking randomness assumptions.

uncertain_points.claim: Resetting aux_rand_q to zero may expose a predictable all-zero entropy value immediately after reset, if the register is used before it is seeded with fresh randomness.
uncertain_points.cond: after reset de-assertion and before the first valid aux_rand_d update
uncertain_points.risk: Security-critical operations could proceed with zero entropy, leading to weak or guessable keys, masks, or nonces.
